description: crates/core/src/ipld/metadata.rs extract_content_type_summary parses the Content-Type header via manual line-by-line iteration and byte scanning, while build_header_map in ipld/header_map.rs uses the mailparse crate for the same family of headers. The two paths have divergent bug surfaces: a fix or normalization applied to the mailparse path will not automatically apply to the ad-hoc path. Already-tested RFC 2047 decoding and header folding edge cases handled by mailparse are absent in the manual path. Fix: call mailparse::parse_content_type or parse the raw header via mailparse::parse_header in extract_content_type_summary and remove the ad-hoc scanning loop.
title: metadata: extract_content_type_summary uses ad-hoc parsing, inconsistent with mailparse elsewhere
